blocks.caption: Biostatistics ke istemal
rows: Clinical trials aur tibbi tehqeeq
nayi dawaon, ilaaj aur aalaat ki hifazat aur asar jaanchne ke liye mutale design aur data ka tajziya
Epidemiology
bimariyon ki taqseem aur phailao ka mutala, khatre ke awamil aur bachao ke iqdamat ki jaanch
Genetics aur genomics
genes aur bimariyon ka taalluq, virasat aur farq ka mutala; zaati (personalised) ilaaj
Awami sehat ki policy
aabadi ki sehat ka tajziya, kamzor groups ki pehchan aur policy ke liye saboot
Mahol ki sehat
aaloodgi aur zehreele maaddon ka sehat par asar naap kar qawaneen ki rehnumai
Bioinformatics
dawa ki daryaft aur tashkhees ke liye genome aur protein ke bare data ka tajziya
Sehat ki khidmat ka miyaar
tashkhees ke tests ki durusti, mareezon ke nataij aur tareeqon ki yaksaniyat
Sehat ke programme
teekon ki muhim, sehat ki taleem aur tarbiyat ke asar ka andaza
Wabaon par qaboo
phailao ka peecha, amwaat ka andaza aur khatre wale groups ki pehchan, foran
Ilaaj mein rukawatein
surveys aur khidmat ke data se rasai ke khalaa dhoond kar kam karna
Sehat ke khatre aur aabadi ka ilm
paidaish, amwaat aur bimari ke rujhanaat ka tajziya taa ke khidmat aur wasail ki mansooba bandi ho

blocks.prompt: Waba ke dauran biostatistics ki madad ka aik tareeqa batayein.
blocks.explanation: Koi aik: bimari ke phailao ka peecha, amwaat ki sharah ka andaza, ya khatre wali aabadi ki pehchan taa ke makhsoos iqdamat hon.

items: Trials, epidemiology, genetics, policy, mahol, bioinformatics, miyaar, programmes, waba, rasai aur aabadi ke ilm mein istemal.
